source: Original board/count/pay/cart and outcome work-line rules.

expected.title: Two crates off the pier
expected.pitch: Two crates of coffee from the lighter at the pier head, to the foot of the crane. Mind the wet planks.

expected.title: Stores for the widow
expected.pitch: Two coils of tarred rope from under the crane to my loading door. Count them twice.

expected.title: Watch the west sheds
expected.pitch: Stand by the barrels at the west sheds till the bell. Keep your eyes open and your mouth shut.

expected.title: A parcel for the Anna Maria
expected.recipient: the mate of the Anna Maria
expected.pitch: Take this to the mate at the gangway before the tide turns. Don't open it. Don't sell it.

expected.title: Sacks to the Entrepot
expected.pitch: Two sacks off the lighter on the Entrepot quay, in at our door. Quick about it.

expected.title: A letter for the pump
expected.pitch: The chapter's letter, to the messenger who waits by the pump on the Handschoenmarkt. Straight there.

jobs.pitch: Stand by the barrels at the west sheds till the bell. Keep your eyes open and your mouth shut.

jobs.title: Watch the west sheds

jobs.title: Mind the carts at the east end

expected.title: Back to the pier head
expected.recipient: Tuur's boy at the pier head
expected.pitch: Bring this from the gangway to my boy at the pier head before the ferry goes. Don't dawdle.

jobs.title: Two crates off the pier
jobs.pitch: Two crates of coffee from the lighter at the pier head, to the foot of the crane. Mind the wet planks.

jobs.title: Stores for the widow
jobs.pitch: Two coils of tarred rope from under the crane to my loading door. Count them twice.

jobs.title: Watch the west sheds
jobs.pitch: Stand by the barrels at the west sheds till the bell. Keep your eyes open and your mouth shut.

jobs.title: A parcel for the Anna Maria
jobs.recipient: the mate of the Anna Maria
jobs.pitch: Take this to the mate at the gangway before the tide turns. Don't open it. Don't sell it.

jobs.title: Sacks to the Entrepot
jobs.pitch: Two sacks off the lighter on the Entrepot quay, in at our door. Quick about it.

jobs.title: A letter for the pump
jobs.pitch: The chapter's letter, to the messenger who waits by the pump on the Handschoenmarkt. Straight there.

jobs.title: Two sacks off the gangway
jobs.pitch: Two sacks of grain off the gangway, in at the Hessenatie door. Keep them dry.

jobs.title: Candles for the ship's cook
jobs.pitch: Candles and matches for the cook at the gangway. He has paid. Into his hands and nobody else's.

jobs.title: Mind the carts at the east end
jobs.pitch: Stand by the carts at the east end till the bell. Nobody touches the barrels, whatever they offer you.

jobs.title: Hides to the west sheds
jobs.pitch: Two bundles of hides from the pier head to the west sheds. They stink, and they are heavier than they look.

jobs.title: Rope back to the chandler
jobs.pitch: Two coils of my rope were left at the west sheds. Bring them back to my door. I shall be watching from the window.

jobs.title: A parcel for the carter
jobs.recipient: the carter at the east end
jobs.pitch: A small parcel for the carter at the east end. Ask him no questions and he will ask you none.

jobs.title: Watch the crates by the crane
jobs.pitch: The crates under the crane want watching till the lighter comes back. Stay put and keep awake.

jobs.title: A barrel of tar
jobs.pitch: One barrel of tar from the Katoen door to my loading door. Roll it gently: it leaks.

jobs.pitch: Take this to the mate at the gangway before the tide turns. Don't open it. Don't sell it.

jobs.title: Sacks to the Entrepot
jobs.pitch: Two sacks off the lighter on the Entrepot quay, in at our door. Quick about it.

jobs.title: A letter for the pump
jobs.pitch: The chapter's letter, to the messenger who waits by the pump on the Handschoenmarkt. Straight there.

jobs.title: A cartload for the natie
jobs.pitch: Five crates off the crane, in at the Hessenatie door. Take my handcart, it stands by the crates, and bring it back where it stood.

jobs.title: Two sacks off the gangway
jobs.pitch: Two sacks of grain off the gangway, in at the Hessenatie door. Keep them dry.

jobs.title: Candles for the ship's cook
jobs.pitch: Candles and matches for the cook at the gangway. He has paid. Into his hands and nobody else's.

jobs.title: Mind the carts at the east end
jobs.pitch: Stand by the carts at the east end till the bell. Nobody touches the barrels, whatever they offer you.

jobs.title: Hides to the west sheds
jobs.pitch: Two bundles of hides from the pier head to the west sheds. They stink, and they are heavier than they look.

jobs.title: Rope back to the chandler
jobs.pitch: Two coils of my rope were left at the west sheds. Bring them back to my door. I shall be watching from the window.

jobs.title: A parcel for the carter
jobs.recipient: the carter at the east end
jobs.pitch: A small parcel for the carter at the east end. Ask him no questions and he will ask you none.

jobs.title: Watch the crates by the crane
jobs.pitch: The crates under the crane want watching till the lighter comes back. Stay put and keep awake.

jobs.title: A barrel of tar
jobs.pitch: One barrel of tar from the Katoen door to my loading door. Roll it gently: it leaks.

jobs.title: Crates to the crane
jobs.pitch: Two crates from the carts at the east end to the foot of the crane. Mind the rails.

jobs.title: Back to the pier head
jobs.recipient: Tuur's boy at the pier head
jobs.pitch: Bring this from the gangway to my boy at the pier head before the ferry goes. Don't dawdle.

expected.title: Two crates off the pier
expected.pitch: Two crates of coffee from the lighter at the pier head, to the foot of the crane. Mind the wet planks.

expected.title: Stores for the widow
expected.pitch: Two coils of tarred rope from under the crane to my loading door. Count them twice.

expected.title: Watch the west sheds
expected.pitch: Stand by the barrels at the west sheds till the bell. Keep your eyes open and your mouth shut.
